patternLabelMap.mind_reading: You filled in what they were thinking
patternLabelMap.emotional_reasoning: You treated the feeling like bad news
patternLabelMap.experiential_avoidance: You left at the hardest moment
patternLabelMap.perfectionism: You needed it to be perfect first
patternLabelMap.distress_intolerance: You couldn't stay with the discomfort
patternLabelMap.recovery_success: You came back after pulling away
patternLabelMap.overcontrol: You tried to control too much
patternLabelMap.overforcing: You pushed and your system pushed back
patternLabelMap.grounded_interpretation: You read the moment for what it was
patternLabelMap.micro_step_success: You found a move small enough to work
patternLabelMap.distress_tolerated: You stayed through the hard part
patternLabelMap.direct_communication: You said what needed to be said
patternLabelMap.flexible_response: You adjusted when it didn't work
patternLabelMap.premature_exit: You protected yourself fast, but stayed stuck
patternLabelMap.post_event_processing: You replayed it until it became something worse

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You entered, sat with people, read the moment accurately, and let it be ordinary.
routeInterpretations.dominantUserFacingPatternLabel: You let the room be the room
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: You gave your brain data it couldn't get from outside. The room wasn't dangerous. Now it knows that—not because you told it, but because you showed it.
routeInterpretations.routeNextRep: Same move, different room. Sit with strangers somewhere else.
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: The fear stays believable when you avoid. You stopped avoiding.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: The gap between what you expect and what actually happens keeps shrinking.
routeInterpretations.routeTransferBridge: One follow-up question. Today. Real conversation.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: Where else do you assume the room is hostile before it proves anything?

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You chose proximity without forcing interaction. You sat near someone, completed the meal, and let that be the whole thing.
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: You found a move your brain could say yes to. That's not settling—that's how you expand what's possible.
routeInterpretations.routeNextRep: One table closer. That's the whole upgrade.
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: You didn't need to be charming or impressive. You just needed to show up. You did.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: Each time you find a workable step, the next step gets easier to see.
routeInterpretations.routeTransferBridge: Public space. One seat closer than comfortable.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: Where else do you demand the full performance when presence would count?

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You misread the tone—your brain started building rejection—and then you caught it. You stayed anyway.
routeInterpretations.dominantUserFacingPatternLabel: You caught the story before it finished writing itself
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: Spirals want to complete. You interrupted one mid-sentence. That's harder than never starting.
routeInterpretations.routeNextRep: Catch it earlier. Name the story before it locks in.
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: You don't have to believe every draft your brain writes.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: The spiral gets shorter each time you interrupt it.
routeInterpretations.routeTransferBridge: Notice when you're writing a story. Don't finish it.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: Where else do you finish the rejection story before reality gets a vote?

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You left. And then you came back. That second entry is the move almost nobody makes.
routeInterpretations.dominantUserFacingPatternLabel: Leaving didn't have to be permanent
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: Escape usually wins forever. You just proved it doesn't have to. Your brain logged 'I can come back' instead of 'I can't handle it.'
routeInterpretations.routeNextRep: If you bail this week, return within 10 minutes. That's the rep.
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: Most people who leave stay gone. You didn't.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: Escape becomes a pause, not a verdict.
routeInterpretations.routeTransferBridge: Next time you bail, give yourself permission to go back.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: Where else do you treat leaving as final when it doesn't have to be?

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You stayed in the space. You ate your meal. You didn't leave.
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: The corner is still in the room. You didn't need to connect to count. You just needed to be there. You were.
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: You met the baseline. Now you can build.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: The corner gets less necessary. The room gets less charged.
routeInterpretations.routeTransferBridge: Public space tomorrow. Ten minutes. Just be there.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: Where else do you show up safely but wonder what happens if you moved one step closer?

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You did the hard thing—you sat with people. But then you turned their flat face into proof they didn't want you there.
routeInterpretations.dominantUserFacingPatternLabel: You filled in the blank with rejection
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: Their face was neutral. You made it hostile. Now your brain treats the story you wrote as evidence. That's the trap.
routeInterpretations.routeNextRep: Before deciding what their face meant, ask: What's the boring explanation?
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: You're not reading their mind—you're projecting yours.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: Every blank face becomes a verdict. The world gets smaller.
routeInterpretations.routeTransferBridge: After your next ambiguous interaction, wait 60 seconds before deciding what it meant.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: Where else do you give blank data a bad meaning?

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You stayed. You talked. And now you're replaying every moment, looking for what went wrong.
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: You can do the hard thing and still turn it into evidence against yourself. The replay is where wins go to die.
routeInterpretations.routeNextRep: After your next real interaction, two minutes max. Then: 'Done.'
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: You did well. The replay lied about it.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: Every interaction becomes a test you probably failed. Even the ones that went fine.
routeInterpretations.routeTransferBridge: Notice when the replay starts. Label it. Redirect.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: Where else do you turn wins into losses after the fact?

stepInterpretations.userFacingPatternLabel: You didn't wait to feel ready
stepInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You entered when your system wanted to hesitate.
stepInterpretations.functionalIntent: Your body wanted more time. You overrode it.
stepInterpretations.immediatePayoff: You're in. The decision is made. No more hovering.
stepInterpretations.reinforcement: Your brain just logged: 'I can enter without waiting for permission from myself.'
stepInterpretations.tryNext: Enter one space 30 seconds faster than feels comfortable.
stepInterpretations.whyThisMatters: The hesitation at the door is where most people get stuck.
stepInterpretations.consequenceIfRepeated: Each direct entry makes the door less significant.

stepInterpretations.whatShowedUp: The phone became a shield between you and the room.
stepInterpretations.cost: The phone says: 'This room requires protection.'
stepInterpretations.reinforcement: Your brain just logged: 'See, I needed it.' The space stays dangerous because you never let it prove otherwise.
stepInterpretations.tryNext: Phone stays in pocket for the first 2 minutes.
stepInterpretations.whyThisMatters: Every time you use it, you confirm the threat.
stepInterpretations.consequenceIfRepeated: The phone becomes required. You feel naked without it.

stepInterpretations.userFacingPatternLabel: You left before the room got a vote
stepInterpretations.whatShowedUp: The door was right there. You turned around.
stepInterpretations.functionalIntent: You wanted to skip finding out.
stepInterpretations.cost: Your brain just logged: 'Confirmed: too hard.' Next time starts harder.
stepInterpretations.reinforcement: Avoidance compounds. Each exit teaches your brain the space is dangerous.
stepInterpretations.tryNext: Tomorrow: enter, stand inside for 30 seconds. No expectations.
stepInterpretations.whyThisMatters: The hardest part is entering. You left before testing that.
stepInterpretations.consequenceIfRepeated: The dining hall becomes a place you 'can't go.' Your world shrinks.

stepInterpretations.whatYouChose: You sat at the group table.
stepInterpretations.functionalIntent: Part of you wanted the corner. You went the other way.
stepInterpretations.immediatePayoff: You're in the game. The decision is irreversible.
stepInterpretations.cost: Your nervous system is lit up. Stakes feel higher.
stepInterpretations.reinforcement: Your brain just logged: 'I can approach, not just observe.'
stepInterpretations.tryNext: Next time, ask one question after sitting down.
stepInterpretations.whyThisMatters: You went toward the thing your brain said to avoid.
stepInterpretations.consequenceIfRepeated: Approaching gets easier. The group table becomes ordinary.

stepInterpretations.userFacingPatternLabel: You stayed, but behind a buffer
stepInterpretations.whatShowedUp: The corner table. Safe. Separate. Still in the room.
stepInterpretations.functionalIntent: You wanted distance from the social pressure.
stepInterpretations.immediatePayoff: You're in the space but protected.
stepInterpretations.cost: You didn't test what happens at the harder option.
stepInterpretations.reinforcement: The corner lets you say 'I went.' But the harder tables stay untested.
stepInterpretations.whyThisMatters: There's a difference between showing up and arriving.
stepInterpretations.consequenceIfRepeated: The corner becomes your default. The rest of the room stays dangerous.

stepInterpretations.whatYouChose: You read their tone as just... neutral.
stepInterpretations.whatShowedUp: Their response was flat. And you let it stay flat.
stepInterpretations.functionalIntent: Your brain wanted to find a signal. You chose not to invent one.
stepInterpretations.immediatePayoff: The moment didn't spiral. You stayed grounded.
stepInterpretations.reinforcement: Your brain just logged: 'Not everything means something. Sometimes people are just there.'
stepInterpretations.tryNext: Next ambiguous moment, ask: What's the boring explanation?
stepInterpretations.consequenceIfRepeated: If you keep reading moments accurately, the default assumption shifts from threat to neutral.

stepInterpretations.userFacingPatternLabel: You wrote rejection onto a blank face
stepInterpretations.whatYouChose: You decided they didn't want you there.
stepInterpretations.whatShowedUp: Their tone was flat. Your brain said: 'They don't want you here.'
stepInterpretations.functionalIntent: Your brain was scanning for threat. It invented one.
stepInterpretations.immediatePayoff: The story makes sense. Your fear feels justified.
stepInterpretations.cost: You just poisoned a neutral moment.
stepInterpretations.reinforcement: Your brain just logged: ambiguity = danger.
stepInterpretations.tryNext: Next flat face, wait 60 seconds before deciding what it meant.
stepInterpretations.whyThisMatters: You're not reading their mind—you're projecting yours.
stepInterpretations.consequenceIfRepeated: Every flat tone becomes rejection. Your world gets smaller.

stepInterpretations.whatShowedUp: Your brain was building a rejection story. You noticed—and stopped.
stepInterpretations.functionalIntent: The spiral wanted to run. You interrupted it.
stepInterpretations.immediatePayoff: You're still here. The moment didn't collapse.
stepInterpretations.cost: The discomfort didn't disappear—you sat with it.
stepInterpretations.reinforcement: Your brain just logged: 'Spirals are interruptible.'
stepInterpretations.tryNext: When the story starts, say: 'That's a guess, not a fact.'
stepInterpretations.whyThisMatters: You interrupted a story before it finished writing itself.
stepInterpretations.consequenceIfRepeated: Spirals get shorter each time you catch them.

stepInterpretations.whatShowedUp: There was a lull. You could have let it pass. You didn't.
stepInterpretations.functionalIntent: Part of you wanted to wait. You went first.
stepInterpretations.immediatePayoff: You're in the conversation now. The passive moment became active.
stepInterpretations.cost: Higher stakes. More to potentially replay later.
stepInterpretations.reinforcement: Your brain just logged: 'I can initiate, not just respond.'
stepInterpretations.tryNext: One follow-up question. Today. Real conversation.
stepInterpretations.whyThisMatters: You went first. Most people don't.
stepInterpretations.consequenceIfRepeated: Speaking up gets easier. Silence becomes optional.

stepInterpretations.userFacingPatternLabel: You stayed through the awkward part
stepInterpretations.whatShowedUp: The silence was uncomfortable. You let it be uncomfortable.
stepInterpretations.functionalIntent: You wanted to fill it, escape it, fix it. You did nothing.
stepInterpretations.immediatePayoff: The moment passed. You're still here.
stepInterpretations.cost: The discomfort wasn't avoided—it was felt.
stepInterpretations.reinforcement: Your brain just logged: 'Awkward silences are survivable.'
stepInterpretations.tryNext: Next awkward moment, let 5 seconds pass before acting.
stepInterpretations.whyThisMatters: You can't engage if you can't stay. You stayed.
stepInterpretations.consequenceIfRepeated: Silence becomes less threatening. You outlast what others flee.

stepInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You left. And then you walked back in.
stepInterpretations.functionalIntent: The relief of escape wasn't enough. You wanted more than safety.
stepInterpretations.cost: Re-entering is harder than entering. You did it anyway.
stepInterpretations.reinforcement: Your brain just logged: 'Setbacks are temporary. Escape isn't final.'
stepInterpretations.tryNext: If you bail this week, return within 10 minutes.
stepInterpretations.whyThisMatters: Most people who leave stay gone. You didn't.
stepInterpretations.consequenceIfRepeated: Leaving becomes a pause, not a verdict.

stepInterpretations.whatYouChose: You started analyzing what went wrong.
stepInterpretations.whatShowedUp: The experience was over. Then you started picking it apart.
stepInterpretations.functionalIntent: Your brain started scanning for what went wrong.
stepInterpretations.immediatePayoff: It feels productive—like you're learning something.
stepInterpretations.cost: The replay turns a neutral moment into evidence against yourself.
stepInterpretations.reinforcement: Your brain just logged: 'Every interaction needs post-analysis.' It doesn't.
stepInterpretations.tryNext: Next social moment: two minutes, then done. No replay after.
stepInterpretations.whyThisMatters: The replay is where wins go to die.
stepInterpretations.consequenceIfRepeated: Every interaction becomes a test you probably failed.

stepInterpretations.userFacingPatternLabel: You let the win stay a win
stepInterpretations.whatShowedUp: The experience ended. You let it settle without picking it apart.
stepInterpretations.functionalIntent: Your brain could have started the replay. You didn't let it.
stepInterpretations.immediatePayoff: The win stays a win. No second-guessing.
stepInterpretations.reinforcement: Your brain just logged: 'Experiences can end without analysis.'
stepInterpretations.tryNext: Next hard conversation, resist labeling it success or failure. Let it just be.
stepInterpretations.whyThisMatters: How you interpret afterward matters as much as what happened.
stepInterpretations.consequenceIfRepeated: Social moments become data, not trials. You stop draining wins.

routeLevel.whatShowedUp: You took a path that didn't fit a mapped route.
routeLevel.reinforcement: Your path was unique. What matters: did you stay, or did you bail?
routeLevel.whyItMatters: Pay attention to where you felt the pull to leave or stay.
routeLevel.ifPatternKeepsRunning: You'll find the routes that fit as you run it again.

routeLevel.whatShowedUp: You moved through a hard moment. That counts.
routeLevel.reinforcement: Every run gives your brain data. Even the messy ones.

stepLevel.functionalIntent: Your brain was managing the moment.
stepLevel.cost: There may have been a different path.
stepLevel.reinforcement: Each choice gives your brain data about what's possible.
stepLevel.tryNext: Notice what you felt here. Try something different next time.
stepLevel.whyThisMatters: You're building awareness of the pattern.

insightBeats.insightText: You grabbed armor before anyone fired a shot. Your system traded 'find out if it's safe' for 'assume it's not.'
insightBeats.whyItMatters: Every time the phone goes up, your brain logs: 'See? You needed it.' The space stays dangerous because you never let it prove otherwise.
insightBeats.tryNextCue: Pocket stays closed for 90 seconds after you enter.

microInterventions.text: Put it in your pocket. Leave it there for one minute.
microInterventions.why: You break the reflex by not completing it.

microInterventions.text: Set it face-down on the table. Hands off.
microInterventions.why: Present but not protecting. Halfway honest.

insightBeats.insightText: Their face gave you nothing. You wrote 'rejection' anyway. You made that up.
insightBeats.whyItMatters: Flat face. You filled it in. Now the blank is 'proof.'
insightBeats.tryNextCue: Ask: what's the most boring explanation for their face?

microInterventions.text: Silently say: 'Or they're just tired.'
microInterventions.why: The boring explanation is almost always the true one.

microInterventions.text: Label it out loud: 'That was a guess.'
microInterventions.why: Calling it a guess breaks its authority.

microInterventions.text: Don't decide yet. Give it 60 seconds.
microInterventions.why: The spiral needs you to conclude fast. Don't.

insightBeats.insightText: Your system said 'not that table' and you went anyway. That override is the whole skill.
insightBeats.whyItMatters: Fear shrinks when you approach what it says to avoid. You just gave your brain data it couldn't get from the corner.

microInterventions.text: You're here. Don't bolt. Let the discomfort settle.
microInterventions.why: Staying through the spike is what changes it.

microInterventions.text: Say one sentence. Anything. The content doesn't matter.
microInterventions.why: Action solidifies approach. Words are secondary.

insightBeats.insightText: You left. And then you walked back in. That second entry is the move almost nobody makes.
insightBeats.whyItMatters: Escape usually wins permanently. You just proved it doesn't have to. Your brain logged 'I can come back' instead of 'I can't handle it.'

microInterventions.text: You're back. That's the win. Nothing else required.
microInterventions.why: Don't add goals. The return is complete.

microInterventions.text: One small thing: sit down, order, look around. Pick one.
microInterventions.why: Low bar protects the recovery.

insightBeats.insightText: You were writing a rejection script and you stopped typing. That interrupt is harder than never starting.
insightBeats.whyItMatters: The spiral wanted you to finish the story. You refused. That's not nothing—that's the skill working in real time.

microInterventions.text: Don't conclude. Hold the not-knowing for 30 seconds.
microInterventions.why: Uncertainty is tolerable. You don't have to resolve it.

microInterventions.text: Stay until the spike passes. Don't leave at peak.
microInterventions.why: Leaving now teaches your brain the peak is unmanageable.

microInterventions.text: Look at them again. Check if the data matches your story.
microInterventions.why: Second look often contradicts first read.

insightBeats.insightText: You stayed, but in a way that kept the room from really happening to you. That's showing up without arriving.
insightBeats.whyItMatters: The corner lets you say 'I went.' But your brain still logged 'too risky to really join.' The fear stays intact.
insightBeats.tryNextCue: Same room. One table closer. Let the hiding place get worse.

microInterventions.text: Look at the group for 5 seconds. No smile. Just look.
microInterventions.why: Looking is half the distance to sitting there.

microInterventions.text: Count who's actually looking at you. It's almost always zero.
microInterventions.why: The spotlight feeling lies. Check it.

microInterventions.text: Finish the meal here. Don't leave early, even from the corner.
microInterventions.why: Early exit erases partial credit.

insightBeats.insightText: You got close enough to feel it—and then you bailed. Your brain just filed 'dining hall' under 'confirmed threat.'
insightBeats.whyItMatters: Escape feels like relief. Your body just logged the peak as 'too much to stay.' Next time starts harder.
insightBeats.tryNextCue: 30 seconds inside. Stand there. That's the whole task.

microInterventions.text: One step back in. That's it. No further goal.
microInterventions.why: Tiny reversal breaks the escape momentum.

microInterventions.text: Shrink the goal: 30 seconds inside, then you can leave.
microInterventions.why: The bar was too high. Lower it to survivable.

microInterventions.text: Say: 'This is the collapse moment.' Don't act on it yet.
microInterventions.why: Naming creates a gap between urge and action.

insightBeats.insightText: Your system scanned for threat and you didn't take the bait. You let neutral be neutral.
insightBeats.whyItMatters: This is what recalibration looks like. One accurate read at a time, the threat detector gets retrained.

microInterventions.text: Mark it: 'Neutral face. I didn't add a story.'
microInterventions.why: Explicit logging strengthens the accurate pattern.

microInterventions.text: Stay a few minutes longer. Extend the data.
microInterventions.why: Duration at accurate interpretation compounds the learning.
